title: Action Comics #750 DC 1999 Superman Stuart Immonen Cover Anniversary Issue
conditionDescription: Bright cover with light handling wear; back cover lightly soiled at the edges. See photos.
descriptionText:
Superman in Action Comics #750 (January 1999), DC Comics - anniversary issue. Cover and art by Stuart Immonen with Jose Marzan Jr. Direct sales, $2.95 cover price.

Back cover: Gap "geektronica" ad.

Condition: bright cover with light handling wear; back cover lightly soiled at the edges (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
